title: Importance and scope of chemistry
notes: **Scope.** Importance and scope of chemistry — Foundation and Fundamentals, Chemistry (class-11-notes).
**Tested.** define it · list: importance, scope of chemistry · one worked example · one misconception each.
**Fact.** Force on moving charge F = q(v×B); on a wire F = BIL sinθ.
**Fact.** Faraday: EMF ε = −dΦ/dt; Lenz's law gives the sign (induced current opposes the change in flux).
**Fact.** Self-inductance L = NΦ/I; inductance stores energy U = ½LI². Mutual inductance M couples two coils.
**Scope of chemistry.** one-line definition + one-line exam use.

mcqs.question: A common examiner point on "Importance and scope of chemistry" is that a statement is only valid when its condition of applicability is met. Is that TRUE or FALSE?
mcqs.explanation: Every NEB rule has a scope (e.g. a specific range, temperature, or sign convention); stating the condition earns full marks.
